description: For a binary relation symbol \(R\), the formula \((\forall u\,R(u,u))\to\exists v\,R(v,x_0)\) is neither prenex nor in negation normal form. The formula \((\exists u\,\neg R(u,u))\lor(\exists v\,R(v,x_0))\) is in negation normal form. The formula \(\exists u\exists v\,(\neg R(u,u)\lor R(v,x_0))\) is prenex with a quantifier-free matrix in negation normal form.
signature:
